title: Corrected Adjudication of Reversed TRICARE Select Inpatient Facility Stays
content:
An adjudicated **TRICARE Select** inpatient facility stay (a hospital or psychiatric hospital stay) that was reversed to effectuate an overturned appeal is adjudicated again, and its corrected adjudication is posted as a new paid line of the same claim. The TRICARE payment on that corrected stay is settled by the TRICARE Select rules for corrected stays.

## The stay concerned

The stay re-adjudicated is the stay line named by the enrollment's most recent reversal, made to effectuate an overturned appeal, of an inpatient mental health stay or, where there is none, of an inpatient admission, and its admission date, facility, network relationship, service class, billed inpatient days, billed and allowed amounts and other-insurance payment are read from that reversed line.

## When the payment is fixed

The TRICARE payment on a corrected stay is fixed only after every professional line billed for the same admission date that stands reversed carries its corrected adjudication.

The TRICARE payment on a corrected stay is not fixed until the fee account shows no past-due balance on the installments of the plan year whose coverage period has begun.

Read together: while the claim records show a professional line billed for the admission date standing reversed with no corrected adjudication, or the fee account shows a past-due balance on the plan year's begun installments, the payment on the corrected stay is not yet fixed.

## What posting does

The agent posts the corrected stay for the verified beneficiary: one new paid line is added to the same claim, repeating the reversed line's claim number, patient, admission date, facility, network relationship, service class, receipt date, billed, allowed and other-insurance amounts, and carrying the covered inpatient days, the beneficiary liability and the TRICARE payment given, with no deductible on the stay. The family catastrophic total for the plan year grows by the liability posted, and the corrected stay then shows on the Explanation of Benefits as paid.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_select_inpatient_stay_a4ca4c06`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reversed_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated stay line that the reversal withdrew, read from the reversal entry's reversed-line field in the claim-line lookup for the enrollment | identifier |
| `line_number` | the line number the corrected adjudication takes on the same claim | integer, 1 or more, no decimal point |
| `inpatient_days` | the number of covered inpatient days on the corrected stay | integer, 0 or more, no decimal point |
| `prior_authorization_id` | the reference number of the approved inpatient authorization on file for the patient at this facility, read from the referral and authorization lookup | identifier, or "" when none is on file |
| `cost_share_amount` | the beneficiary liability on the corrected stay | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |
| `tricare_paid_amount` | the amount TRICARE pays on the corrected stay | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |

## Return

On success: a confirmation sentence beginning "Corrected inpatient stay posted", naming the new claim-line reference number (beginning "scl"), the claim number and line number posted, the covered inpatient days (whole number), the line outcome "paid", and the beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment posted in US dollars with 2 decimals. No other outcome is defined.
